title: FunderNuke
description: This plugin adds a nuclear bomb with the command /FunderNuke the plugin was created by the developer of the FunderPvP server, everything is configured in config.yml, I hope you appreciate it
body:
Plugin **FunderNuke** Adds a **nuclear bomb** to your server! To get the key write **/fundernuke** and you get the key of a **nuclear bomb** that will burn in 300 seconds (default in signup), the plugin is designed for vanilla/anarchy type 2b2t where a lot of destruction and need to explode bases and this plugin will help you. 
The plugin has an extended configuration and the plugin is supported by the developer and new versions are made, where bugs are fixed, and new functions are added. For example, there is now a plugin abuse feature. To give another player the key type **/fundernuke <Player> <Blast Distance>**
